outlets.name: ABC News Australia
outlets.summary: ABC is leading with the widening Sydney Swans misconduct scandal and its fallout for AFL culture, alongside the collapse of US-Canada trade talks and an unusually wet El Nino at home.

items.headline: **A third woman lawyers up over the Sydney Swans misconduct affair**
items.detail: A third woman has engaged legal representation and is weighing civil action over what her lawyer described as an incredibly traumatic experience linked to the Swans hotel scandal.

items.headline: **Ottawa promises to hit back tariff for tariff as the North American trade fight escalates**
items.detail: Washington and Ottawa failed to strike a deal before the deadline and the US is imposing 50 per cent tariffs on a slice of Canadian imports, with Canada vowing dollar for dollar retaliation.

items.headline: **Forecasters say this El Nino could end up the soggiest Australia has ever recorded**
items.detail: Despite El Nino usually signalling drought, ABC's meteorologist reports another rainband is set to soak much of the country this week, putting the season on track for record El Nino rainfall.

items.headline: **The Swans crisis has torn up what was left of the club's celebrated 'Bloods' identity**
items.detail: ABC analysis argues the week of revelations has ended the Sydney club's famed culture narrative and forced a broader reckoning over respect across the AFL.

items.headline: **Ebola vaccine shipment lands in the Democratic Republic of Congo**
items.detail: More than 16,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine have arrived in the DRC as authorities try to contain the latest Ebola outbreak.

outlets.name: SBS News Australia
outlets.summary: SBS is balancing hard international conflict coverage - deadly strikes in Ukraine, Myanmar and Nigeria - with domestic stories on the Swans investigation and Australia's social cohesion inquiry.
outlets.note: Homepage returned images only - headlines taken from the SBS News Just In feed.

items.headline: **Drone barrage on a Ukrainian shopping centre leaves 16 dead**
items.detail: Russian drones struck a mall in Ukraine, killing 16 people and wounding 13 more, including children.

items.headline: **Myanmar air strike kills 14 people at a monastery retreat**
items.detail: A military strike hit a monastery where people were attending a religious retreat, leaving 14 dead.

items.headline: **Rival jihadist factions clash during Friday prayers in central Nigeria**
items.detail: A deadly confrontation between competing militant groups, including Lakurawa fighters, broke out during Friday prayers in Nigeria's Dikera area.

items.headline: **Australian social cohesion inquiry hears the case for change**
items.detail: An inquiry into rebuilding social cohesion in Australia has heard calls for reform following a period of heightened community tension.

items.headline: **Researchers question whether a standard weight measure works for older adults**
items.detail: A new study suggests the so-called obesity paradox means a widely used health metric can be misleading when applied to older people.

outlets.name: RNZ New Zealand
outlets.summary: RNZ's Saturday file is dominated by severe weather and emergencies, with a large Wanaka fire and a run of serious crashes topping the national feed.

items.headline: **Gale force winds slow the response to a major fire near Wanaka**
items.detail: Firefighters are struggling to contain a large blaze at Wanaka as strong winds hamper their efforts.

items.headline: **A police officer is critically hurt after being struck by a fleeing driver in Palmerston North**
items.detail: The officer was left fighting for his life after a car hit him during an incident involving a driver who fled from police.

items.headline: **Heavy rain and severe gales prompt warnings across both islands**
items.detail: Forecasters issued heavy rain warnings for the South Island and severe gale warnings for the lower North Island.

items.headline: **Three people injured in a crash on the Lindis Pass**
items.detail: Emergency services attended a crash on the Lindis Pass in which three people were hurt.

outlets.name: South China Morning Post
outlets.summary: SCMP is leading on Chinese military and diplomatic reach - a survey ship near Taiwan and J-16s deployed to Egypt - while also pushing back on Western criticism of the Tiananmen vigil verdict.

items.headline: **Chinese survey vessel tracked close to Taiwan's main naval base**
items.detail: A mainland Chinese research ship was detected operating near Taiwan's largest naval facility.

items.headline: **Hong Kong rejects Western criticism of the Tiananmen vigil convictions as slander**
items.detail: The Hong Kong government hit back at foreign governments that condemned the court verdict against organisers of the annual June 4 vigil.

items.headline: **PLA J-16 jets touch down in Egypt for a first African exercise**
items.detail: The multi-role fighters flew about 6,000km with mid-air refuelling to join the Eagles of Civilisation 2026 joint drill.

items.headline: **Israeli strikes near the Turkish border raise the risk of an accidental clash**
items.detail: Unannounced Israeli jets operating close to Turkey after Netanyahu ordered strikes on a Syrian airbase could easily have triggered a confrontation with Ankara.

items.headline: **Washington puts 50 per cent duties on US$20 billion of Canadian exports**
items.detail: The tariffs followed the collapse of trade talks, with Prime Minister Mark Carney rejecting what he called unfair US demands and promising retaliation.

outlets.name: CNN
outlets.summary: CNN's front page is anchored by the Iran war and its effect on oil shipping through Hormuz, plus the breakdown of US-Canada trade talks and a court defeat for Trump's visa ban.

items.headline: **Fifty per cent tariffs kick in on Canadian goods after the deadline passes without a deal**
items.detail: Negotiations between Washington and Ottawa failed at the deadline and the higher duties took effect on a set of Canadian products.

items.headline: **Trump brushes off the Iran conflict as 'a little detour' while Tehran stays defiant**
items.detail: CNN's live coverage tracks the president's comments as new sanctions loom and Iran refuses to back down.

items.headline: **A covert tanker operation is quietly holding down global oil prices**
items.detail: So-called dark tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz are dodging Iranian drones to keep crude moving.

items.headline: **Judge throws out the administration's immigrant visa ban covering 75 countries**
items.detail: A federal judge ruled the sweeping suspension patently unlawful, finding officials cannot deny visas on the basis of nationality.

items.headline: **Freed from prison, Tina Peters brings her election fraud claims to Washington**
items.detail: The former Mesa County clerk, released from custody, is touring with her election conspiracy message in the capital.

outlets.name: Fox News
outlets.summary: Fox is focused on midterm campaign attack lines against Democratic Senate candidates and on immigration and crime enforcement stories, with Trump's Iran pressure campaign framed favourably in opinion.
outlets.note: Homepage returned navigation only - headlines taken from the Fox News latest RSS feed.

items.headline: **Trump takes on a heckler at his Myrtle Beach rally for Darline Graham**
items.detail: The president responded to a protester who interrupted his South Carolina rally by joking that the heckler's mother was voting for him.

items.headline: **Court filings detail an alleged online path to radicalisation before a state Capitol bomb plot**
items.detail: Documents allege Jessica Bowie scouted the New York State Capitol five times and acquired bomb-making materials before FBI informants disrupted the plan.

items.headline: **Alaska Democrat's voting record becomes a Senate campaign liability**
items.detail: Records show Senate nominee Mary Peltola missed 794 of 4,265 state House votes and more than a third of Bethel City Council meetings.

items.headline: **Michigan Senate race splits Democrats over a key voting bloc**
items.detail: Mike Rogers launched a Democrats for Mike coalition as Jewish voters raised concerns about Abdul El-Sayed's position on Israel.

items.headline: **Astronauts from the Artemis II mission to receive the Congressional Space Medal of Honor**
items.detail: Trump will present the award to the crew at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston on August 28.

outlets.name: The Wall Street Journal
outlets.summary: The Journal is leading on pressure inside Iran to end the war and on the collapse of the US-Canada tariff negotiations, with additional focus on Russia and the Americas.
outlets.note: Paywalled - headlines via the Dow Jones World News RSS feed.

items.headline: **Senior Iranian figures press for a negotiated end to the fighting**
items.detail: Iran's president and parliamentary speaker argue Tehran should bargain its way out of the war and stabilise the economy while it still has leverage.

items.headline: **Last-ditch tariff talks collapse and Washington imposes 50 per cent duties on Canada**
items.detail: Negotiations broke down on Friday night and Ottawa said it would respond with retaliatory tariffs on American goods.

items.headline: **Eight killed when a plane goes down near an isolated Alaskan radar station**
items.detail: The civilian-contracted aircraft crashed at a remote military radar site roughly 450 miles from Anchorage.

items.headline: **The collapse of Russia's last antiwar party lays bare Putin's weak spots**
items.detail: Yabloko survived for decades through self-censorship, but the Journal reports the Ukraine war made that compromise impossible to sustain.

items.headline: **Sinaloa's governor resumes his duties despite a US indictment**
items.detail: Governor Ruben Rocha, accused by American prosecutors of links to leaders of a major drug cartel, has returned to office.
